### SubscribeDNSConfiguration

:material-waves: streaming (requires `more`) · :material-new-box: since v258

Sends the complete global and per-link DNS configurations when any changes are made to them. The current configurations are given immediately when this method is invoked.

```go
func (c *Client) SubscribeDNSConfiguration(ctx context.Context, in SubscribeDNSConfigurationIn) iter.Seq2[*SubscribeDNSConfigurationOut, error]
```

### ResetServerFeatures

:material-new-box: since v262

Flushes all feature level information the resolver learnt about specific servers, and ensures that the server feature probing logic is started from the beginning with the next look-up request.

```go
func (c *Client) ResetServerFeatures(ctx context.Context, in ResetServerFeaturesIn) error
```

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `allowInteractiveAuthentication` | `?bool` | Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. |

### DNSOverTLSMode

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `no` | DNSOverTLS is disabled. |
| `yes` | DNSOverTLS is enabled. |
| `opportunistic` | Try to use DNSOverTLS, but disabled when the server does not support it. |

### ResolveSupport

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `no` | The protocol is disabled. |
| `yes` | The protocol is enabled. |
| `resolve` | The protocol is used only for resolving. |

### ResolvConfMode

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `uplink` | /etc/resolv.conf is a symbolic link to /run/systemd/resolve/resolv.conf. |
| `stub` | /etc/resolv.conf is a symbolic link to /run/systemd/resolve/stub-resolv.conf. |
| `static` | /etc/resolv.conf is a symbolic link to /usr/lib/systemd/resolv.conf. |
| `missing` | /etc/resolv.conf does not exist. |
| `foreign` | /etc/resolv.conf is not managed by systemd-resolved. |

### DNSServer

Encapsulates a DNS server address specification.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `address` | `[]int` | IPv4 or IPv6 address of the server. |
| `addressString` | `?string` | IPv4 or IPv6 address of the server, formatted as a human-readable string. |
| `family` | `int` | Address family of the server, one of AF_INET or AF_INET6. |
| `port` | `int` | Port number of the server. |
| `ifindex` | `?int` | Interface index for which this server is configured. |
| `name` | `?string` | Server Name Indication (SNI) of the server. |
| `accessible` | `bool` | Indicates if the DNS server is accessible or not. |

### SearchDomain

Encapsulates a search domain specification.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | Domain name. |
| `routeOnly` | `bool` | Indicates whether or not this is a routing-only domain. |
| `ifindex` | `?int` | Interface index for which this search domain is configured. |

### DNSConfiguration

Encapsulates a global or per-link DNS configuration, including configured DNS servers, search domains, and more.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ifname` | `?string` | Interface name, if any, associated with this configuration. Empty for global configuration. |
| `ifindex` | `?int` | Interface index, if any, associated with this configuration. Empty for global configuration. |
| `delegate` | `?string` | Delegate name, if any, associated with this configuration. Empty for global or link configurations. |
| `defaultRoute` | `?bool` | Indicates whether or not this link's DNS servers will be used for resolving domain names that do not match any link's configured domains. |
| `currentServer` | `?DNSServer` | DNS server currently selected to use for lookups. |
| `servers` | `?[]DNSServer` | Array of configured DNS servers. |
| `fallbackServers` | `?[]DNSServer` | Array of configured fallback DNS servers, set for global configuration only. |
| `searchDomains` | `?[]SearchDomain` | Array of configured search domains. |
| `negativeTrustAnchors` | `?[]string` | Array of configured DNSSEC negative trust anchors. |
| `dnssec` | `?string` | DNSSEC mode. |
| `dnssecSupported` | `?bool` | Indicates if the current DNS server supports DNSSEC. Always false if DNSSEC mode is "no". |
| `dnsOverTLS` | `?DNSOverTLSMode` | DNSOverTLS mode. |
| `llmnr` | `?string` | LLMNR support. |
| `mDNS` | `?ResolveSupport` | mDNS support. |
| `resolvConfMode` | `?ResolvConfMode` | resolv.conf mode, set for global configuration only. |
| `scopes` | `?[]DNSScope` | Array of current DNS scopes. |

### DNSScope

Encapsulates a DNS scope specification.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `protocol` | `DNSProtocol` | Protocol associated with this scope. |
| `family` | `?int` | Address family associated with this scope. |
| `ifindex` | `?int` | Interface index associated with this scope. |
| `ifname` | `?string` | Interface name associated with this scope. |
| `dnssec` | `?string` | DNSSEC mode associated with this scope. |
| `dnsOverTLS` | `?DNSOverTLSMode` | DNSOverTLS mode associated with this scope. |
